name: redis-persistent
description: Redis with automatic backups to persistent storage

scripts.setup:
# Redis uses native Linux filesystem for data
# Volume is used for backups accessible from Windows

# Configure Redis with custom settings
cat >> /etc/redis/redis.conf << 'EOF'

# Custom persistence settings
bind 0.0.0.0
appendonly yes
appendfilename "appendonly.aof"
appendfsync everysec
save 900 1
save 300 10
save 60 10000
maxmemory 256mb
maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
EOF

# Set permissions
mkdir -p /var/lib/redis
chown -R redis:redis /var/lib/redis

# Restart Redis with new config
service redis-server restart
sleep 2

# Check if backup exists and restore it
if [ -f /mnt/redis-backups/dump_latest.rdb ]; then
  echo "Restoring from RDB backup..."
  service redis-server stop
  cp /mnt/redis-backups/dump_latest.rdb /var/lib/redis/dump.rdb
  chown redis:redis /var/lib/redis/dump.rdb
  service redis-server start
  sleep 2
fi

# Create backup script
cat > /mnt/redis-backups/backup.sh << 'BACKUP_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
BACKUP_DIR="/mnt/redis-backups"
DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR/archives"

redis-cli BGSAVE
sleep 3

if [ -f /var/lib/redis/dump.rdb ]; then
  cp /var/lib/redis/dump.rdb "$BACKUP_DIR/dump_$DATE.rdb"
  rm -f "$BACKUP_DIR/dump_latest.rdb"
  ln -s "dump_$DATE.rdb" "$BACKUP_DIR/dump_latest.rdb"
  echo "RDB backup: $DATE"
fi

if [ -f /var/lib/redis/appendonly.aof ]; then
  cp /var/lib/redis/appendonly.aof "$BACKUP_DIR/aof_$DATE.aof"
  echo "AOF backup: $DATE"
fi

find "$BACKUP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 \( -name "dump_*.rdb" -o -name "aof_*.aof" \) -type f | sort -r | tail -n +6 | xargs -I {} mv {} "$BACKUP_DIR/archives/" 2>/dev/null
BACKUP_EOF

chmod +x /mnt/redis-backups/backup.sh

# Create initial backup
/mnt/redis-backups/backup.sh

echo ""
echo "=============================================="
echo "Redis Ready!"
echo "=============================================="
echo "Connect: redis-cli"
echo "Backups: /mnt/redis-backups/"
echo "Create backup: /mnt/redis-backups/backup.sh"
echo "=============================================="
